_meta.step: Step 9: External Call Encoder (Option B: Bi-GRU)
_meta.input: Ordered list of external call names ["socket", "bind", "listen"]

step_1_embedding_lookup.description: Each external function name → dense vector via nn.Embedding

step_2_bigru.description: Bidirectional GRU processes the sequence of call embeddings

forward_gru.note: Captures 'socket then bind then listen' sequential pattern

output.description: Single vector encoding the external call pattern of this function

no_external_calls_example.note: The gate in Step 10 will learn to push g → 1.0 for this case, effectively ignoring c
